reviewer: Codex /root; same-context mathematical self-review, not independent human or theorem review
conditional_scope: Formula/specification review only; no empirical assumption, originality, GPU interface or efficacy verified.

formal_object.rationale: Eligible anchor a, anchor-error covariance Sigma_a, local output sensitivities J_ta and later error eta_t; actual per-anchor cost k_a. The stated object/domain, rather than the official unsquared Chamfer, is the object of this conditional derivation.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: C04: e_t=J_ta e_a+eta_t+remainder -> Separate propagated common error from later errors; condition: Local linearization with controlled remainder; C05: Frozen decoder around each legal anchor -> Local anchor sensitivity; condition: Differentiability holds in the chosen neighborhood; D03: Choose among finite anchors under declared cost -> Finite resource-constrained design; condition: Risk/cost surrogate is actually estimated on allowed evidence All current edges remain conditional where model/data availability is not established.

derivation.rationale: The propagation expansion requires centered later noise uncorrelated with anchor error. The cross-time covariance formula is only for t!=s; at equal times later-noise covariance remains. Cauchy-Schwarz bounds the omitted remainder contribution by 2 sqrt(R_linear) r+r^2. Actual covariances, sensitivities and costs are unmeasured.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: True Sigma and remainder bounds are not automatically calibrated by decoder perturbations.; If later noise correlates with anchor error, its cross terms must be retained.; Every selected anchor must still generate all original frame IDs and eligible temporal context.; Additional anchor reconstructions are paid in total compute; baseline gets the same search allowance. These are obligations, not observations about ActionBench.

method_expression.rationale: Estimate a bounded anchor-risk proxy from allowed model/input evidence, choose one anchor prospectively and generate the complete animation. The reviewed construction is Finite anchor-design decision using a propagated error/cost model.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: Sensitivity-weighted risk should predict downstream degradation better than reference-frame confidence alone; benefit should diminish when anchor sensitivities are alike. It can be rejected by: Reject if an equal-budget simple image-quality/visibility selector or fixed anchor matches the native result, or estimated anchor risk does not transfer. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.

closest_alternative.rationale: Named alternatives: Classical optimal experimental design and anchor selection; first-frame ActionMesh and a simple legal image-quality selector. Claimed operational difference: Explicit propagation and correlated-time error, rather than arbitrary changing of anchor index; real costs and calibration remain unknown. This check verifies an explicit comparator and conditional delta, not completed novelty clearance.
